metadata.description: Deployment location.
Suffix used to keep deployment names unique.
MLZ identifier (max 3 chars).
Deploy Bastion in core MLZ hub.
Defender for APIs pricing plan (P1 = up to 1M API calls/month; required by the Microsoft.Security/pricings 'Api' resource).
Assign the Microsoft cloud security benchmark (MCSB) initiative — the Defender CSPM baseline — in audit-only mode. Available in Azure Government and Commercial.
When true, creates a new Entra security group and uses its Object ID for VM login RBAC.
Display name for the auto-created Entra security group. Used only when autoCreateEntraGroup is true.
Resource ID of an existing Log Analytics workspace. Leave empty to use the MLZ-provisioned workspace.
Optional custom name for a new Log Analytics workspace created in the workload resource group.
Optional custom Storage account name (3-24 chars, lowercase alphanumeric only).
Optional custom Container Registry name (5-50 chars, alphanumeric).
Optional custom SQL Server name (1-63 chars, lowercase, numbers, hyphens).
Optional custom SQL Database name. Defaults to 'defenderdb'.
Optional custom Blob container name. Defaults to 'coverage-container'.
Object ID of the Entra user, group, or service principal for VM login. Leave empty when autoCreateEntraGroup is true.
Add the lab firewall rule collection group (Intune/MDE/Arc/Entra/Linux/PKI + Azure service tags) to the MLZ hub firewall policy.
Also allow the workload subnet outbound to the AzureCloud service tag (all Azure services). Broad; appropriate for a lab.
'us' = Azure Government / GCC High; 'com' = commercial.
Upstream DNS the DC forwards to (hub firewall private IP when DNS proxy is on, else 168.63.129.16).
Deploy the Azure Arc Private Link Scope + Arc private DNS zones (preview API).

Install Content Hub solutions and enable all matching built-in analytics rules + UEBA (via the in-template deploymentScript when deploySentinelContentScript is true, otherwise run by the GitHub Action / Cloud Shell).
CSPM coverage: deploy a Key Vault for Defender for Key Vault.
Deploy the CSPM sample Azure SQL server/database. Turn off if the subscription is not yet enabled for SQL in the region.
CSPM coverage: deploy an App Service plan (B1) + web app for Defender for App Service.
CSPM coverage: deploy API Management + a sample API for Defender for APIs.
API Management SKU for the CSPM sample. Developer works in all clouds (slow to provision); v2 tiers are fast where available.
